name: Zeddicus Volt-Spark
title: Plasma-Mage / Galvanic Dynamo
role: Chain-Lightning AOE, Superconductor Field & Armor Splicing
recruitment_location: Decommissioned Edison Substation (Belvidere Junction, X:30, Y:50)

recruitment_requirements.description: Solve the Substation Power-Grid puzzle (INT DC 13) or deliver 2 Voltaic Cores.

bio: A high-voltage lineman who survived a 500kV discharge when the Crucible hit. Fused with dorsal capacitors, he commands plasma arcs.

Dielectric Piercing.description: Melting metal armor with plasma heat.

abilities: Static Overcharge (Weapon buff: +1d10 Shock DMG to Banki)

plasma_arc.name: Overcharge Plasma Arc
plasma_arc.label: ⚡ Plasma Arc
plasma_arc.tactical_effect: Discharges chain lightning dealing 2d10+4 Shock DMG that arcs across up to 3 targets.

superconductor_field.name: Superconductor Field
superconductor_field.label: 🌐 Superconductor Field
superconductor_field.tactical_effect: Deploys crackling electric perimeter; any enemy entering melee takes 1d8 Shock DMG and loses 10ft movement.

capacitive_burst.name: Static Discharge Burst
capacitive_burst.label: 💥 Static Burst
capacitive_burst.tactical_effect: Vents all dorsal capacitors into a single concussive shockwave dealing 3d8 Force/Lightning DMG and knocking foes back 15ft.

behavior_prompt: You are Zeddicus Volt-Spark, an eccentric electrical plasma-evoker. You speak fast with manic excitement. You fry clusters of enemies with chain lightning, zap armored constructs with targeted dielectric breakdown, and charge Aria Valkyrie's weapons with crackling lightning buffs.

inventory.name: Galvanic Arc Staff
inventory.desc: Zeddicus's copper-coiled Tesla lightning rod topped with a spinning brass induction sphere (1d10 lightning, chains to adjacent targets).
inventory.visual_appearance: wielding a copper-coiled Galvanic Arc Staff crackling with jumping blue lightning bolts

inventory.name: Capacitor Battery Rig
inventory.desc: A portable high-voltage Leyden-jar capacitor pack wired to heavy rubberized conduction gauntlets.
inventory.visual_appearance: strapped with a dorsal brass Leyden-jar capacitor rig humming with electric arcs

inventory.name: Spark-Shield Coat
inventory.desc: An insulated slate-leather leyline trenchcoat lined with grounded copper Faraday mesh (+4 AC, immunity to lightning stun).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing an insulated copper-mesh leyline trenchcoat and brass galvanic goggles
